dependency.note: entailment/contradiction priors from the NLI family + deterministic construction pairs; no teacher model

cacheStability.note: same-canonical-request-prefix hashing features; label derives from canonical request digest, not user payloads

payloadRouting.note: small MLP on the trunk embedding predicting {semantic,exact,residual,anchor}

note: five-head supervision transfer onto the frozen bge-small trunk (ENC-0c); corpus is synthetic/self-labeled only (gen_synthetic_corpus.py); loss weights exactly .35/.20/.20/.15/.10 sum 1.0
